cards.text: The prophet Zechariah has been seeing visions in the night, with an angel showing him what they are (Zechariah 1:8-9). Now the angel shows him Joshua the high priest (not the Joshua who led Israel after Moses), standing before the angel of the LORD. And standing right at Joshua's right hand, of ALL the people who could be standing there, is Satan.

cards.question: Satan is standing at the right hand of Joshua the high priest to ___ him.
Satan is there to accuse Joshua the high priest. Then the LORD speaks, and He talks straight to Satan. What does He say?

answers.text: You may test him for a time

cards.text: Then the LORD asks about Joshua: "Is not this man a firebrand snatched from the fire?" Not strolled out, not politely escorted, SNATCHED, like me grabbing a tray out of the oven when the timer's been going off for ten minutes.
Now look at Joshua, standing there before the angel. Check out what he's wearing, friend, and take your time with it.

cards.question: Joshua the high priest stands before the angel dressed in clean garments.
So the angel gives an order to those standing before him about Joshua. What is it?

answers.text: Send him out of the camp
Let him wash in the river

cards.question: Then the angel tells Joshua that something of his has been removed: his ___.
The angel also promises Joshua something new to wear: splendid robes.

cards.text: Zechariah is just watching this vision, and then he jumps right in with a request. That's me when somebody else decorates a batch: "Hold on, hold on. Let me add ONE thing."

cards.question: Zechariah asks them to put a ___ turban on Joshua's head.

cards.text: So a clean turban goes on Joshua's head, and they clothe him while the angel of the LORD stands by. Filthy clothes OUT, splendid robes IN, and friend, I've only seen one makeover like that, and it was mine, the night I got called out of the back of a junk drawer.

cards.question: Then the angel of the LORD gives Joshua a charge from the LORD of Hosts, and it starts with an "if." What does Joshua have to do?

answers.text: Walk in His ways and keep His instructions
Rebuild the wall around all of Jerusalem
Offer a lamb on the altar every morning

cards.text: And if Joshua does, the LORD says Joshua will govern His house and have charge of His courts. Friend, that's not a promotion, that's the keys to the whole bakery.

cards.question: The LORD also promises Joshua a place among the ones standing there in the vision.

cards.text: The LORD goes on, telling Joshua and his companions seated before him that they are a sign. Then comes a promise: "For behold, I am going to bring My servant, the Branch."
Next the LORD speaks of a stone He has set before Joshua, with seven eyes on that one stone. He says He will engrave an inscription on it.

cards.question: Joshua's iniquity has been removed. Now the LORD of Hosts says He will remove the iniquity of this land too.
The LORD of Hosts says He will remove the land's iniquity in a single day. On that day, He says, "you will each invite your neighbor" to do what?

answers.text: Sit under your own vine and fig tree
Stand guard with you on the city wall
Help you rebuild the house of the LORD

cards.text: And that's where we'll leave Zechariah for now. Keep your apron on, friend, because this prophet is not done seeing things yet.
